children: George Risk Industries reported quarterly net sales of $6,850,000 and declared an increased annual cash dividend of $1.25 per share.
Quarterly net sales $6,850,000, up 16.14% year-over-year, driven by resilient demand and core product lines.
Net income $2,192,000 and earnings per share $0.45 for quarter ended July 31, 2026.
Fiscal year-to-date sales up 10.27%; OEM sales rose 9.25%, with strong commercial/industrial demand.
Board declared annual dividend $1.25 per common share, up $0.25 vs prior year; record date Sept 30, 2026, payment by Oct 31, 2026.
Product backlog for heavy duty metal contacts and water detection sensors; new products in development including explosion-proof contacts and wireless sensors.
